title.narrative: Strengthening Economic Management and Governance Program (Subprogram 1)

description.narrative: The program enables the government to address structural weaknesses in mobilizing domestic resources, enabling investment climate, facilitating trade and logistics, and promoting transparency and good governance. A programmatic approach with two subprograms ($600 million each) is designed to sequentially implement complex reforms focusing on three reform areas: (i) fiscal management strengthened; (ii) state-owned enterprise (SOE) governance and investment climate improved; and (iii) trade policy and logistics strengthened. Subprogram 1 supports the government in initiating tax expenditure rationalization, tax administration automation and digitalization, data transparency, public investment management (PIM) system improvement, SOE governance and fiscal risk monitoring strengthening, regulatory environment streamlining, and trade facilitation.

Reform area: Fiscal management strengthened
Outcome: Revenue from (i) Income Tax increased by 25%, and (ii) VAT increased by 30%.
Description: 1.1. To improve tax collection and compliance, the National Board of Revenue (NBR), through the Finance Act 2024 (i) replaced the retrospective taxation regime with a prospective taxation regime;b (ii) mandated universal self-assessment based return filing; (iii) expanded coverage of the withholding tax net;c (iv) enforced compulsory furnishing of proof of returns for business license renewal for additional business types;d (v) enforced penalty measures for failure to show proof of tax returns in business premises; and (vi) rationalized income tax expenditures, especially those relating to capital gains.
1.2. To enhance transparency and accountability of income tax administration, the NBR (i) established the Electronic (E) -Tax Management Unit, and the TDS (tax deduction at sources) unit, with a focus on providing dedicated support to women taxpayers; and (ii) issued circulars to its concerned departments to (a) publish the detailed data (in anonymized way) from FY2026 onwards used for tax expenditure analysis, and (b) provide secured access of a representative panel of anonymized taxpayers' data for independent research purposes from FY2026.f
1.3. To increase VAT collection and rationalize VAT expenditure, the NBR removed VAT exemption and extended the uniform VAT rate of 15% to several products and services. h
1.4. To provide dedicated support for female taxpayers, the NBR issued circular to all tax branches, including providing information on gender-specific rules and regulation in the Tax Code.j
1.5. (i) To improve the efficiency, transparency, and mobilization of non-tax revenue, the Finance Division issued a guideline on non-tax revenue (NTR) l and non-NBR taxes m (land development tax, road tax, stamp duty, and others) to all ministries and agencies; and (ii) and to reduce congestion and air pollution, the NBR introduced an environmental tax on the owners of more than one vehicle.
1.6. To enhance the efficiency and development effectiveness of public investment, the Planning Commission approved the Public Investment Management (PIM) Reform Program 2024-2028.
To streamline the approval of the public projects through enhanced digitalization, the Planning Commission integrated the Ministry Assessment Format (MAF) and Sector Assessment Format (SAF) system with the Project Appraisal Management System (PAMS) and Project Processing Appraisal and Management System (PPS).

Reform area: Fiscal management strengthened
Outcome: Revenue from (i) Income Tax increased by 25%, and (ii) VAT increased by 30%.
Description: 2.1. The NBR (i) through its Finance Act 2025, will further (a) broaden the income tax net and strengthen enforcement and compliance mechanisms for tax collections and (b) reduce the income tax and VAT expenditures; and (ii) will introduce audit of digital economy services.e
2.2. NBR, (i) to reduce tax compliance burden and increase the effective tax net, will implement a comprehensive taxpayers' outreach and support strategy; (ii) to enhance compliance risk management, will (a) establish Risk Management and Tax Intelligence Wing g, (b) establish an integrated data base management and analytics platform, (c) conduct joint IT and VAT audit for at least 15 high risk tax units, (d) select at least 20% of VAT and income tax (IT) units for auditing through the automated compliance risk management system; and (iii) to deepen efficiency, transparency of tax administration, will (a) commence the implementation of a “whole of NBR” comprehensive digital transformation program, and (b) provide secured access of anonymized taxpayers' data for independent research purposes.i
2.3. To further eliminate VAT exemptions and modernize the VAT system, the NBR will (i) increase the VAT coverage of 15% VAT rate for an additional set of products and services; (ii) introduce mandatory e-invoicing system in the VAT large tax units (LTUs) and (iii) implement a consistent set of criteria for mandatory inclusion of taxpayers in the VAT and income tax LTUs.
2.4. To further promote gender inclusion, the NBR will (i) introduce gender-disaggregated data collection for tax analysis; (ii) establish dedicated tax clinics and outreach services for women taxpayers, and (vi) conduct skills upgrading and training programs targeting female tax officials.k
2.5. To deepen the efficiency, transparency, and mobilization of non-tax revenue, the Finance Division of Ministry of Finance, will enact a comprehensive NTR policy that will focus on climate change and establish integrated database management system of all NTRs.
2.6. The Planning Commission will implement the PIM Reform Program 2024-2028 by (a) forming a National Coordination Committee (NCC) to supervise the PIM reform activities, and (b) implementing enhanced PIM tools including rolling out digital multi-year public investment program (MYPIP) in at least 10 of the 15 economic sectors.
To enhance finance plus value addition, efficiency, and accountability of project selection, execution, and evaluation, the Planning Division will update and implement its Guideline for Public Investment Project Preparation, Processing, Approval, and Revision. n
